name: Etoy padshey yascheritse do sih por snitsya plamya
original_name: Этой падшей ящерице до сих пор снится пламя
source:
The flame chases away the darkness.
The flame turns everyone and everything already dead to ashes.
The flame does not burn the dragon.

Delivering a small parcel turned into a dangerous adventure for a young mercenary, Licht "Lucky" Luckeian. Waking up in the ruins of an ancient city hidden deep inside a mountain, he found himself facing giant insects, ancient secrets, and corruption. Will Licht be able to return to the world under the sun, moon, and stars — and, more importantly, come to terms with himself? Because he, too, is full of secrets.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
火焰驱散黑暗。
火焰将所有已经死去的所有人和一切都化为灰烬。
火焰不会烧伤龙。

对于年轻雇佣兵Licht“Lucky”Luckeian来说，运送一个小包裹变成了一次危险的冒险。在一座隐藏在大山深处的古城废墟中醒来，他发现自己面临着巨大的昆虫、古老的秘密和腐败。利希特能否回到日月星辰之下的世界，更重要的是，能够接受自己呢？因为他也充满了秘密。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248840/]Steam[/url]]
